rq1.rationale: Central system-level nanosatellite SysML repository with reusable/generic design patterns and parametric conceptual design.

rq2.rationale: Claims traceability, interoperability, reuse, consistency, risk/productivity benefits, but limited evidence and not EPS reliability-focused.

rq3.rationale: Includes requirements-linked mass/power budget verification and test-case traceability, but no detailed EPS verification procedure model.

bibliographic_review_management.lineage_overlap_notes: Reuses FireSat SysML model elements and cites Spangelo et al. standard CubeSat MBSE work; treat as related lineage but NSS-1 case is distinct.

mission_platform.form_factor_or_size: not_reported; requirement states total mass less than 50 kg
mission_platform.organization_type: SUPARCO agency/industry context with university student development
mission_platform.project_maturity: ongoing case study; initial MBSE repository for conceptual/preliminary design

study_context_population.context_notes: Independent systems engineering team performs SE tasks while university students develop units; multidisciplinary local aerospace and academic investigators participate.

mbse_objective_scope_artifacts.stated_objective_pain_point: Assist existing SE processes by improving traceability, consistency, requirements definition/validation, parametric relationships, and interfaces to existing tools; address manual error-prone parametric mismatch.
mbse_objective_scope_artifacts.system_boundary_and_abstraction: Top-level NSS-1 system includes space segment, ground segment, and launch services; satellite space segment decomposes into payload, EPS, CDHS, ACS, RFCS, TCS, and structure/support. EPS is abstracted to power/mass values and budget constraints rather than detailed physical EPS components.
mbse_objective_scope_artifacts.prior_behavioral_domain_knowledge: Authors emphasize that aerospace engineers need MBSE/SysML/OOP training; behavior is introduced gradually through state, activity, sequence, and use-case diagrams. No explicit method for modeling with minimal behavioral knowledge is provided beyond abstract patterns and parametrics.

implementation_steps_or_phases.inputs: Candidate MBSE methodologies from INCOSE survey and organizational lifecycle needs
implementation_steps_or_phases.handoffs_or_completion: Method mapped to phases and artifacts

implementation_steps_or_phases.outputs: Requirements baseline, requirement and use-case diagrams
System breakdown, BDD/IBD, parametric diagrams, trade/design-space exploration
Subsystem/unit behavior and performance models using state, activity, and sequence diagrams

implementation_steps_or_phases.step: Phase D assembly integration and testing
implementation_steps_or_phases.outputs: Unit/subsystem/system test cases and V&V traceability
NSS-1 SysML repository, MBSE/SysML/tool training, model reuse path to NSS-2
implementation_steps_or_phases.actors: SUPARCO systems engineers, modeling group, academic investigators

implementation_pathway_tailoring.tailoring_notes: Hybrid approach explicitly bridges conventional Office/STK/MATLAB practices and model-based SysML adoption; it is not presented as a full playbook.

toolchain_interoperability_lifecycle_con.toolchain_architecture_data_flow: SysML repository in MagicDraw stores requirements, architecture, behavior, and parametric constraints. Excel can import/export values to/from SysML/ParaMagic instance slots. MATLAB functions/scripts are treated as SysML constraints by InterCAX; local MATLAB execution writes output text read back into SysML. Simulink can be accessed through MATLAB scripts. Direct STK-SysML integration is future work, with possible Excel intermediate or SLIM.
toolchain_interoperability_lifecycle_con.syntax_semantic_continuity: Partially supported through SysML semantics, requirements links, constraint blocks, and generated tables/code; continuity to STK and physical test is incomplete.
toolchain_interoperability_lifecycle_con.software_hardware_system_integration_rea: Software readiness is described through generated code structures and onboard software use cases; hardware/system integration readiness is limited to phase-D test-case traceability, with no hardware integration evidence.
toolchain_interoperability_lifecycle_con.availability_reproducibility: Tools and versions are reported, but no model, scripts, spreadsheets, plug-in configuration, or package is made available.

eps_verification_specific.eps_requirements_representation: System power budget requirement of 80 W and OBC power requirement are shown in requirements diagram; EPS block has EPS_mass and EPS_power values; Power_MoS constraint verifies power requirement.
eps_verification_specific.evidence_integrated_into_model: Mass and power requirements are linked to constraint blocks using «verify» relationships in SysML; ParaMagic/MATLAB SMT solves and updates model instances.
eps_verification_specific.eps_verification_limit: No EPS-specific test procedures, SIL/HIL, automated tests, solar/battery behavior, or hardware integration are reported.

claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.claim_text: MBSE/SysML improves consistency, traceability, V&V, and change-impact assessment compared with document/tool-spread traditional SE.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.artifact_process_linked: SysML model repository, requirements diagrams, trace/derive/satisfy/verify/refine relationships, generated traceability and verification matrices.

metric_or_value_indicator.rationale: Traceability and verification matrices are discussed qualitatively; no counts are given.

claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.observed_effect_size_or_qualitative_effe: Qualitative: authors state tool-generated matrices and impact analysis are time-saving and helpful for NSS-1 V&V; no effect size.

evidence_source.quote: MBSE provides a consistent and automatically traceable system design, which enhances the quality of traceability and change impact assessment.

Being able to ask a modeling tool to generate requirement traceability and verification matrices, and to perform an automated impact analysis when the requirements change, is an important time-saving feature for systems engineering.

claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.threats_or_alternative_explanations: No measured trace coverage, defect rate, or comparison with the previous process; benefits may follow from disciplined requirements work rather than SysML alone.

claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.claim_text: SysML parametric constraints linked to requirements verify NSS-1 mass and power budget margins before physical development.

specificity_of_claim.rationale: Power-budget claim is specific to EPS supply/demand at subsystem budget level, not detailed EPS design.

claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.artifact_process_linked: Mass_Balance and Power_Balance constraint blocks, Figure 9 parametric diagram, Figure 12 verify relationship, ParaMagic/MATLAB SMT solver.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.observed_effect_size_or_qualitative_effe: mass_MOS=0.082 and power_MOS=0.47, both positive, verify the mass and power requirements; no baseline.

evidence_source.quote: After connecting the parameter ports to respective inputs and outputs, we validated the model using ParaMagic.
We can see that mass and power budget margins are calculated to be positive (mass_MOS=0.082 and power_MOS=0.47), which verify the mass and power requirements

claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.threats_or_alternative_explanations: Verification covers simple budget equations only; input values and assumptions are not independently validated; no physical EPS test or full EPS behavior model.

claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.claim_text: Connecting SysML to Excel and MATLAB/Simulink enables interoperability and on-the-fly parameter tuning using existing SE tools.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.artifact_process_linked: MagicDraw Excel import/export, ParaMagic instance slots, InterCAX MATLAB integration, intermediary MATLAB scripts for Simulink.

metric_or_value_indicator.rationale: On-the-fly/fast tuning is claimed qualitatively; no time metric.

claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.observed_effect_size_or_qualitative_effe: Qualitative data-flow demonstration between SysML, spreadsheets, and MATLAB; no quantified tuning-time reduction.

evidence_source.quote: Seamless interface of existing system-level design tools (Satellite Tool Kit [STK], matrix laboratory [MATLAB]/ Simulink, and Microsoft Excel) with the SysML satellite model to assist on-the-fly parameter tuning
MagicDraw provide an interface to import and export data between the SysML model and Microsoft Excel files.
When the SysML product calls MATLAB, the subject MATLAB function or script runs locally ... and creates an output text file that is automatically read back into the SysML model.

claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.threats_or_alternative_explanations: STK direct integration is future work; interfaces rely on proprietary plug-ins and local scripts; no semantic consistency checks across tools are reported.

claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.claim_text: The NSS-1 model repository supports reuse, generic nanosatellite patterns, and knowledge transfer to future missions such as NSS-2.

mbse_mechanism.rationale: Other = knowledge transfer and design-pattern capture.

claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.artifact_process_linked: FireSat-derived elements, NSS-1 SysML repository, common design patterns, Figure 2 model reuse path to NSS-2.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.observed_effect_size_or_qualitative_effe: Qualitative reuse path; no reuse across multiple completed missions is demonstrated.

evidence_source.quote: We reused some model elements from the FireSat SysML model
The modeling repository uses SysML to capture common design patterns of the typical nanosatellite class
The NSS-1 model repository developed during this phase can be used effectively for knowledge transfer.

claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.threats_or_alternative_explanations: Reuse for NSS-2 is prospective; no released reusable library/template or replication evidence.

claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.claim_text: Automatic report/table/code generation from SysML supports automated systems engineering and downstream simulation/software implementation.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.artifact_process_linked: Allocation tables, requirement tables, coverage analysis, code structure in Java/C++/C#.

metric_or_value_indicator.rationale: Other = generated allocation/requirement tables and code skeletons.

claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.observed_effect_size_or_qualitative_effe: Generated artifacts are described; no generated artifact sample counts, defect reduction, or implementation evidence.

evidence_source.quote: from SysML models, an allocation table, a requirement table, and coverage analysis are generated automatically from the model repository
we can also generate the corresponding code structure for the SysML model in popular object-oriented programming languages

claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.threats_or_alternative_explanations: The paper does not show generated reports/code or demonstrate software integration outcomes.

claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.claim_text: Extensible SysML structures reduced model development time and are expected to reduce future cost to change designs.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.artifact_process_linked: BDD physical architecture and extensible system structures.

metric_or_value_indicator.rationale: Both are qualitative indicators without numeric measurement.

claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.observed_effect_size_or_qualitative_effe: Authors state reduced model development time and future cost-to-change reduction, without quantitative effect size.

evidence_source.quote: We have also adopted design techniques for creating extensible system structures. This practice reduced the model development time. In the future, this will also reduce the cost to change the design

claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.threats_or_alternative_explanations: No time/cost data or baseline; future cost reduction is prospective.

claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.claim_text: Overall MBSE approach is promising for reduced development risk, improved quality, and increased productivity.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.artifact_process_linked: General NSS-1 model repository and concluding synthesis of advantages.

metric_or_value_indicator.rationale: No risk, quality, or productivity metric is reported.

evidence_source.quote: The model-based approach is found to be promising for a reduced development risk, improved quality, and increased productivity.

claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.threats_or_alternative_explanations: Could reflect author expectation from method adoption rather than observed NSS-1 outcomes.

claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.claim_text: SysML diagrams improve communication and make missing or relevant design information easier to find.

mbse_mechanism.rationale: Other = formal SysML semantics and visual stakeholder-readable diagrams.

claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.artifact_process_linked: Use-case diagrams, package navigation, formal diagram semantics, model repository.
claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.observed_effect_size_or_qualitative_effe: Qualitative: diagrams can be inspected by stakeholders and point out missing design information.

evidence_source.quote: Users, project managers, analysts, developers, quality-assurance engineers, and anyone else interested in the system as a whole can inspect these diagrams and understand what the system is supposed to accomplish.
The SysML model and diagrams can point out missing design information, and relevant information about a particular design element can easily be found.

claimed_outcomes_value_mechanisms_eviden.threats_or_alternative_explanations: No stakeholder evaluation; authors also warn diagrams may be misinterpreted without SysML training.

gap_mapping.gap_notes: Strongest contributions are implementation pathway and tool-interface demonstration. Governance/ROI and NewSpace/agile alignment remain weak. Lightweight tailoring is mostly staged hybrid adoption for a student/nanosatellite program rather than measured low-overhead MBSE.

key_findings_by_rq.rq1: High relevance: an OOSEM/SysML repository models an NSS-1 nanosatellite mission/system with requirements, architecture, behavior, interfaces, budgets, and reusable patterns for typical nanosatellite class; it does not fully solve minimal behavioral-knowledge modeling beyond abstract patterns and parametrics.
key_findings_by_rq.rq2: Partial relevance: authors claim traceability, consistency, interoperability, reuse, automation, risk/quality/productivity benefits; evidence is strongest for power/mass margin requirements checking and tool data flow, weakest for broad ROI/productivity/risk claims. No EPS reliability outcome evidence beyond a reliability budget artifact is presented.
key_findings_by_rq.rq3: Partial relevance: requirements-in-the-loop and parametric checks verify mass/power requirements before physical development; SysML test cases and verification matrices are reported generally, but no detailed EPS test procedure, SIL/HIL, automated test, or hardware/flight verification is shown.

extractor_identified_limitations_gaps: strong dependence on proprietary MagicDraw plug-ins

synthesis_consistency.lineage_consistency_notes: Code as FireSat/standard CubeSat lineage reuse, not as an independent reusable reference model validation across missions. Differentiate NSS-1 case-specific repository from Spangelo standard CubeSat framework.
synthesis_consistency.extraction_confidence_reason: Paper markdown is readable with detailed methodology, figures, and toolchain. Main uncertainty concerns exact venue and evidentiary strength of broad outcome claims, not classification of methods/artifacts.
